messages:
maya: Heads-up — we discovered the eval-run from last fri failed during trace upload. ~230k per-sample traces never landed in S3. I want to propose a backfill + sampling plan so we don't spike storage but still catch regressions. PTAL.

noah: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Do we know failure mode? network timeout or runner OOM? :eyes:

maya: eval-bot posted errors: 'UploadError: multipart upload aborted' and then the runner retried and gave up. infra-bot shows 504s to the upload gateway around 02:12 UTC. Looks like transient gateway issue but we still need to re-ingest.

eval-bot: ERROR report: failed_upload_count=230123, affected_models=[gptj-6b-quant,gptj-6b-fp16], datasets=[candqa_v2,summaryset_v1].

ritesh: If we re-run everything raw it will cost a lot. My preference: full traces for failures + stratified sample of successes. Idea: keep all 'fail' traces, sample 5% of low-loss, 20% of medium-loss, 100% of high-loss. Also ensure each model-dataset-commit bucket has at least N=50 samples.

frances: +1 on stratified. We also need to preserve edge cases for quant experiments (tokens with >50% unk or long generations). Maybe add a heuristic: keep full traces where gen_len > 512 or generated_tokens contains <UNK> marker.

sam: Can we compress on ingest? gzip JSONL and store with gzip+parquet for cheaper storage. Also consider storing a lightweight index (metadata only) permanently and raw traces for 90 days. That way dashboards can rehydrate when needed.

maya: Draft policy I'm imagining: - Raw compressed traces: 90 days (backfilled subset) - Critical failures & high-loss bucket: keep 365 days - Aggregated metrics (per-sample reduced rows): keep indefinitely in parquet - Backfill output prefix: s3://redwood-eval/backfill/2026-03-??/  - Backfill manifest with checksums and uploader job id.

noah: Sounds reasonable. For sampling percentages, can you spell exact thresholds? I want deterministic rules we can implement in backfill job.

maya: Proposed thresholds: loss_percentile < 30 -> sample 3% ; 30-70 -> 15% ; 70-95 -> 60% ; >95 -> 100%. Always include any example with failure_flag=true or gen_len>512. Enforce per-bucket min_samples=50.

ritesh: Implementation note: do stratified reservoir sampling per (model, dataset, commit). Use a seeded RNG so we can reproduce. Also emit a sampling_manifest JSONL like:

```
{"model":"gptj-6b-quant","dataset":"candqa_v2","commit":"abc123","sample_rate":0.15,"seed":42,"selected_count":150}
```

sam: For CI wiring: add a check in eval-harness CI that verifies backfill_manifest exists and selected_count >= expected_min for each critical bucket. Fail the job when manifest missing. Also add a periodic job that validates checksums.

frances: For dashboarding: we'll need a 'trace_availability' signal per (model,dataset,commit) so alerting can trigger when <80% expected coverage for regression test prompts. That should be in Redwood Console as a table + heatmap tile.

maya: Backfill run command prototype:

```
python tools/backfill_traces.py \
  --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-07 \
  --strategy stratified --seed 42 \
  --output s3://redwood-eval/backfill/1769959000/ \
  --min-samples 50
```

ritesh: A couple more infra points: 1) uploader should use multipart with 10MB part size and retry(5). 2) tag objects with metadata: x-eval-job=1769959000, x-model, x-dataset. 3) keep manifest with sha256 checksums.

infra-bot: Notice: starting capacity reservation for backfill job may be required. Requesting 2x normal runner quota for 4 hours to avoid delaying prod jobs.

noah: How do we detect if the backfill itself fails partially? We should have per-batch checkpoints and a summary report. If partial-failure > 1% then fail the whole backfill and escalate.

maya: We'll emit a final report JSON at s3://redwood-eval/backfill/1769959000/report.json with fields: attempted_count, uploaded_count, skipped_count, failed_count, failed_buckets. Example schema snippet below: 

```
{"attempted": 230123, "uploaded": 178912, "skipped": 20000, "failed": 31011}
```

sam: We also need to update eval-ingest lambda to accept small compressed archives and validate manifest checksums before acknowledging.

frances: QA: add a step to replay selected samples into the eval harness locally and run the critical regression test suite. We should compare new metrics to baseline and fail if delta > threshold.

maya: I'll draft a PR with the backfill job + sampling implementation + CI checks. Planning to run a small smoke backfill on a subset tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ritesh: Thanks Maya. Happy to review the PR.

noah: Add me to the smoke run.

maya: Will do. I'll @noah @ritesh on the PR and ping infra.

infra-bot: Scheduled: backfill-smoke-job for 1769959000 queued at 2026-03-20T09:30:00Z.
